*Anthropic quietly becomes wealth management's plumbing — right as it files to go public.*

## 📡 Radar
**Bubble anxiety is consolidating.** Citadel's "no margin for error," BlackRock's move to neutral, and recurring Burry/Griffin GPU-overcapacity warnings [73](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5) are converging on the same caution the same week.

**Anthropic as systemic node.** An IPO-bound model vendor becoming advisor infrastructure means its uptime and economics now sit on the industry's risk register — watch the ANT prospectus.

**Credit discipline arriving.** Lenders demanding AI cash flow [98] plus Rieder's 7% AI bonds [60] signal the AI financing story is shifting from equity narrative to debt underwriting.

**Regulatory scaffolding firming.** The EU AI Act's first harmonised technical standard landed [102](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNTXlnTmhiNkotcVM5VEQyQmZzN2tBc1VFNDdldmlXLXJvdy1xMHFoQWRUZ0JFUDRlTGUxdGVNcHFrNWdrUjVJbkRMNDh5QVZ2QUhfbk45clVOMUVpM01FR2huRjM5OWRyNkcySGY2M0gxeWUxM0NkclNnTUk4N0wyWlBQSkFLXzk2bm1EY05Cci12d0ptelBRelZUSEhmVTdlVW9YcjhRaVgzNVQ0?oc=5), and the SEC's 2027 exam priorities keep familiar themes with evolving-market emphasis [110](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxPR1pib0s5bEVCRS1rc3hUVVQ2X3VTbDhyR1pDb01XMklvYThYSzZ5cFFWZzlCNjJvNnNlZTljZ01lZDBkTFhzWDVjVDRyeEZqbEl1SjU4dldwVlJtc3BaSXhRaTZBVFRxZDBBZEVTV19xWUhwRHlYTVYyLVdZVVlKamRB?oc=5).

- NYC Health + Hospitals "AI tools" entries (35, 39, 41, 42) are SEO spam, not news — skipped.
- "Quant Group" robot/kitchen items (47, 56, 66) and the Quant token (71, 75) are name collisions, not quant funds.
